'''Chris Schaut''' (also published as '''Chris Shaut''' and '''Chris Shauts''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2001 New York City tournament]] on 10 February 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down Beatdown]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1733">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-14-decipher-day-in-nyc-10-feb-01d1733/ decipher-day-in-nyc-10-feb-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 14 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-14-decipher-day-in-nyc-10-feb-01d1733/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Chris Schaut also played at [[June 2001 Albany tournament (23 June)]] on 23 June 2001 with Pile (a.k.a. Hayes' brilliant pile), according to Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2506">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-albany-boston-invades-yet-againd2506/ albany-boston-invades-yet-again], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 24 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-24-albany-boston-invades-yet-againd2506/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Chris Schaut also played at [[RamapoCon III Open]] on 9 June 2001 with [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|AOBS podracing]], according to Mike Gemme's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2450">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twad2450/ ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twa], DeckTech (michael "Deck" Gemme, 13 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-13-ramapo-uncensored-easy-sloppy-twad2450/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
